tasks.label: ПРАВИЛО
tasks.q: First conditional for real future possibilities: If + present simple, will + verb (If you take this knife, you won't be able to give it back). Unless = if not (He won't survive unless he stays still). After when, as soon as, until, before, after we also use the present, not will: The knife won't go back until it tastes blood. As soon as the guards arrive, we'll search the walls.
tasks.q_pl: First conditional for real future possibilities: If + present simple, will + verb (If you take this knife, you won't be able to give it back). Unless = if not (He won't survive unless he stays still). After when, as soon as, until, before, after we also use the present, not will: The knife won't go back until it tastes blood. As soon as the guards arrive, we'll search the walls.

end_good.title: Місію виконано!
end_good.text: Уранці варта знаходить у підвалі палацу схованку з харконненським пультом. Вбивці вже немає. Туфір довго мовчить, а потім ставить на твоєму плані червоний хрестик: «Тут. Якби ти не ходив коридорами вночі, ми б ніколи цього не знайшли».
end_good.text_pl: Rano straż znajduje w piwnicy pałacu kryjówkę z harkonneńskim pilotem. Zabójcy już nie ma. Thufir długo milczy, a potem stawia na twoim planie czerwony krzyżyk: „Tutaj. Gdybyś nie chodził nocą po korytarzach, nigdy byśmy tego nie znaleźli”.
end_good.text_en: In the morning the guards find a hiding place in the palace cellar with a Harkonnen controller. The assassin is gone. Thufir is silent for a long time, then puts a red cross on your plan: “Here. If you hadn't been walking the corridors at night, we would never have found it.”
